# ECOFLOT

ECOFLOT provides waste removal, soil removal, construction debris removal, container rental and special-equipment services in Odintsovo, Moscow and the western Moscow region.

Official website: https://ecoflot.pro/
Language: Russian
Primary service area: Odintsovo, Moscow, Moscow Region, including Krasnogorsk, Zvenigorod, Aprelevka, Istra, Naro-Fominsk, New Moscow, Rublyovo-Uspenskoye and Minskoye directions.

## Main services

## Equipment
ECOFLOT uses its own and partner fleet for waste and material handling, including multilifts, bunker trucks, dump trucks, loaders and grapple-equipped vehicles.
